Forest plot of cross-validation comparisons

Source: R/plot-functions.r
hbr_plot_cv_forest.Rd

Displays the paired CV comparison of M2 vs M0, M3 vs M0 and M3 vs M2 per trait, with bootstrap confidence intervals. Points whose interval excludes zero are coloured by the palette's superior colour; the rest are drawn in the muted text colour. Use this as the headline figure for the honest-vs-naive comparison.

Usage

hbr_plot_cv_forest(
  x,
  metric = "r",
  palette = "haplobreed",
  theme = "haplobreed",
  output_dir = NULL,
  file_name = "cv_forest",
  width = 8,
  height = NULL,
  formats = c("pdf", "png"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

An `hgsi_advanced` object or the `cv_compare` table.

metric

Metric to display. `"r"` by default.

palette

One of [hbr_palette_names()].

theme

One of [hbr_theme_names()].

output_dir

Directory for the figure. `NULL` returns the plot.

file_name

Base file name (without extension).

width, height

Figure dimensions in inches.

formats

Output formats.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, `list(plot = <ggplot>, files = <character>)`.

Examples

cmp <- data.frame(
  trait     = rep(c("YLD", "DTF"), each = 3),
  method    = rep(c("M2", "M3", "M3"), 2),
  baseline  = rep(c("M0", "M0", "M2"), 2),
  metric    = "r",
  mean_diff = c(0.05, 0.02, 0.03, 0.04, 0.01, 0.03),
  boot_lo   = c(0.01, -0.01, 0.00, 0.01, -0.02, 0.00),
  boot_hi   = c(0.09, 0.05, 0.06, 0.07, 0.04, 0.06),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hbr_plot_cv_forest(cmp)
